description: Use domain-rich language in testing tables. Replace generic JSON with concrete, descriptive language tied to domain concepts. Real data and examples for all inputs/outputs. Example: 'Payment with amount -50.00 (negative)' not '{"payment": {"amount": -50}}'.

do.description: Domain-rich language with concrete examples. Example: 'Payment with amount -50.00 (negative amount violates rule)' not generic JSON

guidance.description: Describe actual problems in domain terms
example: 'Payment with amount -50.00' (negative amount violates validation rule)

guidance.description: Use real data values, not placeholders
example: rule_name='validate_positive_amount', line_number=2, violation_message='Payment amount must be positive'

dont.description: Don't use generic JSON or abstract descriptions. Example: '{"payment": {"amount": -50}}' (generic), 'Payment with invalid data' (vague)

guidance.description: Don't use raw JSON without explanation

example: 'Payment with invalid data' (WRONG - what makes it invalid?)
